project.name: Langdyke
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 7 of 15: every required category, all four named trail providers, local HES/NRHE completeness, dates, access, transport and dogs were checked before continuing. The English Langdyke reserve is unrelated and excluded. Markinch and Kennoway facilities are outside this settlement.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Langdyke is retained for regional completeness, but a strict-boundary current-web audit found no independently visitable attraction, café-led daytime stop, maintained place-specific trail, public picnic facility, visitor car park or public toilet.
